description: Original personal correspondence between Chabot and O'Keeffe and Stieglitz. The bulk of this series is letters from O'Keeffe to Chabot dating from the 1940s and relating to her daily life back east as well as the renovation of the ruined adobe hacienda that O'Keeffe purchased in 1945 in the village of Abiquiu. Many of the letters from Chabot to O'Keeffe are in draft form only.
title: Correspondence
